The lighter has a brushed metal finish with visible engravings/logos on the side. A small flame is visible at the top, illuminating the scene. The background is dark and out of focus, with hints of yellow objects.

The edges of the engraving also blend slightly into the metal texture rather than having sharp, cut-depth definition.

The geometry of the top part where the flame emerges is somewhat amorphous. The connection between the flame and the nozzle is not physically precise; the flame seems to float slightly above or merge weirdly with the metal housing. The mechanical details (windguard holes, wheel) lack crisp structural logic.

The fingers show some unnatural smoothing and lack of fine skin texture detail, appearing slightly 'waxy' or overly blurred compared to the sharpness of the metal, suggesting potential generative smoothing artifacts.
